inventory.classification_scope: Repository serverless design only; not proof of live retirement

environment_recovery.content: Variable names, classifications, management location and consumers only; historical values require separate encrypted owner-controlled recovery

gates.phase9: Release-bound live acceptance and completed approved observation required
gates.authority: Supabase production writer/read target and current evidence; VPS production writes stopped
gates.routing: Pinned frontend API, complete active A/AAAA/CNAME chains, no VPS aliases/IPs or stale fallback
gates.reconciliation: Current authenticated bounded batch, approved backlog/retry/lease/failure/conflict limits
gates.backups: Frozen VPS Mainnet and current authoritative Supabase encrypted off-Git backups with checksums and independently verified restore/catalog/count/full-column integrity
gates.host_sharing: UNKNOWN blocks all eligibility; YES allows isolated WizPay workload review but blocks subscription; NO permits cancellation review only after every gate

validation.isolated_postgresql: PASS: PostgreSQL 15 -> 17 native dump/restore, clean retry, schema/catalog/count/full-column equality and unchanged source; read-only Phase 10 reconciliation SQL preserves all 15 application tables
validation.serverless_artifact: PASS: packaged Redis-free API and persistence/recovery tests; no Phase 10 code imported by application
validation.scoped_eslint: PASS: apps/backend/src/phase10/*.ts and deployment evidence verifier
non_blocking_warnings: Existing artifact trace warnings covered by actual packaged tests
Frontend build Reown remote configuration DNS unavailable; local fixture build and browser tests passed. Hosted wallet/provider evidence remains deferred

runbooks.ci_retirement: Preserve manual SSH workflow until live Phase 9 acceptance and final approval; prevent dispatches/running deployments before scoped retirement; no workflow disabled now

deferred_manual_pc: Hosted Supabase authentication/connectivity and designated target verification
Vercel authentication, dedicated backend deployment/environment configuration and hosted smoke
Final production read-only export, hosted Supabase import and complete integrity verification
Hosted feature acceptance and interactive wallet/provider evidence
Deliberate single-authority frontend switch, approved observation, Phase 9 live acceptance or safe rollback
Current Phase 10 read-only health/authority/reconciliation/routing/integration checks and private release-bound evidence
Both independently restored encrypted backups, archive/tag and secure secret-recovery verification
Inspect all host workloads/resource ownership; UNKNOWN is not cancellation eligibility
Final owner approval, scoped service retirement, post-shutdown safe checks, credential/CI retirement and evidence record
Subscription cancellation only if verified host-sharing NO and all other gates pass
evidence_policy: Offline passing evidence never substitutes for hosted production acceptance or authorizes shutdown. Private operator receipts/backups/secrets stay outside Git. No real production data or credentials are included.
